title: Major Waste, Housing, Public Safety Initiatives
summary:
*   A comprehensive briefing opened the meeting, focusing on public safety issues, criminology, and the Austin Police Association.
*   Approved a $2.6 million contract for the construction of the South Austin Transfer Station and leased a motor grader for the FM 812 landfill.
*   Supported affordable housing by approving the sale of city-owned lots for low-to-moderate income housing and increased funding for a down payment assistance program.
*   Postponed the extra garbage sticker program for solid waste, lifting the expiration date on complimentary stickers, and initiating plans for variable rates and hardship exceptions.
